notes: §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR5: in CF, PH, PF and RF groups "SOURCE clauses and associated USE statements must not reference" a group containing a control data item, an item subordinate to one, or a redefinition or renaming of any part of one, and "In page heading and page footing report groups, SOURCE clauses and USE statements must not reference control data-names." The SOURCE half is ScreenSourceControlData (below 2002, COBOL6825) over SourceControlRelation and StorageExtent. Probes at --std 85: PH SOURCE of the control item (witness), CF SOURCE of the group holding it, PF SOURCE of a subordinate, RF SOURCE of a REDEFINES of part, CF SOURCE of a RENAMES of part are all refused; CF and CH SOURCE of the control item itself ran; --std 2002 accepts the witness. Gap: the USE half is not made (the member's summary says so, and kb/Work PB5079 landed without it): a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure for a page heading that references the control data-name, or for a control footing that references the group containing it, compiles and runs. kb/Work PB5424 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-03.json).

next.reason: 1985: "SOURCE clauses and associated USE statements must not reference any of the following: a. Group data items containing a control data item."; 2023: "The 2023 TYPE clause syntax rules (SR-13.18.57.3-9 to -16) cover the report group types but state no limit on SOURCE/USE references to control data". The 2023 TYPE clause rules cover report group types, yet none bars SOURCE or USE in CF, PH, PF or RF groups from referencing control data items, their groups, subordinates or redefinitions.
